thread:
tim: Quick triage for Q2 infra roadmap — need to lock GPU SKU commits for EU and SG rollouts. We have constrained H100 capacity and three main options: reserve extra H100 in EU, do a mixed H100+A10x rollout for SG, or slide SG by ~4 weeks. Please weigh in with customer impact + gating criteria.

carol: Can you share the customer list & deadlines? we should prioritize by revenue risk.

maria: Customers flagged: AcmeHealth (enterprise, SG prod target May 20), FinStack (EU+NA, flexible), Learnly (EU only, May 1). AcmeHealth is the one with strict SLA.

aj: Short data point — current fleet utilization for H100 pools is 82% during peak windows; we can squeeze short bursts but sustained extra capacity needs reservations. Lead time from vendor for new H100 nodes is ~9–11 weeks. Spot/burst availability for SG is decent for the next 2–3 weeks but unstable.

olivia: From product/OKR side: top priorities are (1) hit customer commitments, (2) keep unit inference cost delta <15% vs baseline, (3) maintain regional latency SLOs. If we delay SG, it hurts customer 1 and OKR 1.

aj: Proposal A (reserve EU H100): order 8 H100 racks for EU committed capacity. Pros: meets Learnly + FinStack growth, stable. Cons: long lead time, capital commit.

aj: Proposal B (mixed SG): deploy H100 for critical routes + A10x for noncritical inference. Pros: faster turn-up via A10x, lower cost. Cons: potential latency/regression for enterprise prompts.

aj: Proposal C (delay SG 4 weeks): buy us time to refill H100 pools. Pros: avoids overcommit. Cons: AcmeHealth misses date — needs commercial remediation.

carol: Can we quantify revenue at risk for AcmeHealth if delayed? urgent to know tradeoff.

maria: AcmeHealth ARR ~ $1.2M ARR; their onboarding bonus is dependent on May 20. We risk churn or credit.

tim: Given that, leaning toward mixed approach for SG as a stopgap and reserve EU H100 for stability. But call is: do we commit to PO for EU H100 now? reactions: :one: reserve EU H100, :two: mixed SG stopgap, :three: delay SG. Please react by EOD.

procure-bot: Reminder — procurement lead times: H100 rack vendor A (preferred) ETA 70–77 days; vendor B ETA 60–85 days with variable pricing. PO templates: `PO-H100-standard-v2.docx`.

aj: If we go mixed SG, ops action: create routing rules to send enterprise prompts to H100 pool, fallback to A10x for lower-priority workloads. We'll need canary + latency regression tests. Suggested gating criteria:
- Canary run for 48h with <1% error rate
- P95 latency within 1.2x of baseline for enterprise prompt set
- Cost per 1k tokens delta measured and OKd by finance

olivia: Add launch gating: PM sign-off on customer communications + support playbook, sales confirmation that credits/penalties are agreed.

carol: Also add a rollback plan: automatic fallback to hosted backed endpoints if regional rollout degrades. Ops must have runbook.

maria: If mixed SG accepted, Sales will offer AcmeHealth a one-month credit rather than delaying their launch — cheaper than losing ARR. Confirm?

aj: I can set up spot pools and routing rules this week for the mixed plan. I'll also draft PO numbers for EU reserves in case we pull trigger.

tim: OK — preliminary consensus = :two: mixed SG stopgap + prep to reserve EU H100 if occupancy doesn't drop below 70% in next 3 weeks. Action items:
- aj: provision mixed SG routing + canary (due in 4 days)
- aj: draft EU H100 PO options and cost scenarios (due next Tue)
- maria: confirm AcmeHealth credit offer and acceptance (due EOD tomorrow)
- carol: draft runbook and rollback steps (due 3 days)
- olivia: update OKR tracker and notify impacted PMs (due EOD)

tim: Thanks all. We'll reconvene Wed 10am if any of the gating checks fail or if vendor lead times change.

maria: quick note — leaving this thread here for audit: sales committed language saved to CRM.

aj: adding preliminary numbers in case useful: EU PO 8 H100 ~ $1.12M CAPEX + 6% freight/taxes. Mixed SG incremental infra ops ~ $8–12k/mo.

carol: got it. tagging follow-ups in Asana. :white_check_mark:

tim: End of thread.
